scope: Normal resident KV real-process semantic-unit streaming; no sleep gaps

rows.source: actual prebuilt local process; CPU work, no sleep

method.residency: No save, forced eviction or restore; preserve evaluated prefix through active task; normal session close between independent tasks
method.build: Identical prebuilt helper/command; no compilation or incremental-build optimization during task; first-exec/warmup recorded separately
method.order: Rotate modes by replicate; no best run selection, no evaluation tuning
method.flow: 512/3072-word history; six actual read/test-fail/write/test-pass/read/test-pass calls; direct versus resident coordinator; Native prepare+first greedy after each; scripted actions
method.stream: 1024-word initial context; actual process reads12 immutable units at80/240 words, with0/40M real compute iterations per unit; wait-all/coalesced/eager; no artificial sleep
method.metrics: Task wall and post-input/post-tool waiting separated from cumulative prefill/decode, producer CPU and actual arrival times; common work and interference charged
method.oracle: Flow12 fresh references, per-call oracle measured after first token and first5 excluded from raw six-call wall; stream4 fresh references after normal stream close, first token sampled before all oracle work

limits: One M5/Metal/Qwen0.6B; scripted actions test actual execution and resident compatibility, not model autonomy
Initial history/model load and prebuilt helper first-execution warmup excluded and recorded; lazily compiled GPU variants may remain in first measured tasks, all repeats retained
Native stable history has no additional prefill work while tools run without new data; coordinator overhead is measured rather than invented speedup
Streaming uses complete immutable independent message units from a real local process, not arbitrary cloud token chunks or vendor SSE
Stream tools remain empty, worker exclusive; no automatic agentctl stream scheduling or combined Native/Stream owner overlay
No build-command optimization added to these timing comparisons; no physical KV shrinking or Windows/CUDA acceptance

sanitizers.scope: Final resident stream collector, canonical/fresh-greedy checks after normal close, first-token and complete-close timing, producer completion; cxf/adapters/helper instrumented, upstream prebuilt excluded

unchanged_native_stream_regression.scope: Production hashes unchanged from full Native14K/existing Stream acceptance in qualification2; final collector separately rerun under ASan

initial_qualification_failure.reason: Diagnostic simultaneous fresh-reference and resident receiving KV exceeded shared8192 slot pool; reference moved after normal stream close, no workload/capacity change
